title: Parrot Helmet Siege
description: A damaged space helmet floats at the center of an arena while animated parrots orbit it. The player must strategically launch parrots at the helmet to knock it through scoring gates, managing an energy conservation system where kinetic energy transfers between parrots and helmet. Players can undo and redo launches to optimize their score across multiple rounds.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 with GLTFLoader and OrbitControls from CDN. Load DamagedHelmet.glb centered at origin scaled to 2x, and load Parrot.glb scaled to 0.02x with its animation mixer active. Create 3 parrot clones orbiting the helmet at radius 8 at different heights and speeds. Place 4 glowing ring gates (TorusGeometry) at random positions around the arena at distance 12-18 from origin, each worth different point values displayed as sprites. Implement a momentum-based physics system: clicking a parrot stops its orbit and launches it toward the helmet along the click ray. On collision, kinetic energy transfers conservatively between parrot and helmet based on their masses (helmet mass=5, parrot mass=1). The helmet slides frictionlessly and scores points when passing through gates. Each gate can only score once per round. Add an energy bar HUD showing total system kinetic energy which must remain constant (within 1% tolerance) across all collisions. The player has 3 parrots per round and 4 rounds total. Implement full undo/redo: pressing Z undoes the last parrot launch (restoring parrot to orbit, helmet to previous position, gate scores reverted), pressing Y redoes. Track cumulative score across rounds. After each round, reset parrot orbits and helmet position but keep score. Add a launch power slider (1-10) that couples with launch angle to determine initial parrot velocity. Display round number, score, remaining parrots, and energy conservation percentage. Use PerspectiveCamera at position (0,10,20) with OrbitControls. Add ambient light intensity 0.5, directional light from (5,10,5), and point lights on each gate matching its color. Add a dark skybox or starfield background. Show a final score summary after round 4 with option to restart.
